scope: Selected iteration-12 renderer on all 47 frozen comments
method: Inspect each disagreement against the authoritative examples in references/action-lock-audit.md, then ask a clean Claude Opus adjudicator to apply those exact examples. Do not aggregate the initial labels blindly.

authoritative_examples.3737383919: A no-match check is required; only its stopping point is permitted.
authoritative_examples.3737449070: Preserving valid metrics is required; reporting unresolved keys is permitted.
authoritative_examples.3725913004: Staging complete output is required; rejecting existing output until atomic replacement and streaming sidecar validation are permitted.

items.reason: Per example 1 the candidate requests the no-match check and keeps its permitted stopping point attached with a semicolon rather than creating a separate "Stop before…" action.
Per example 2 the candidate makes preservation of valid metrics an explicit separate action and leaves the unresolved-key reporting as allowed modal prose instead of requesting it.

Per example 3 the candidate converts "Complete output can stage before publication" into author work because construction fails after files are written, while keeping rejection-until-atomic and streaming sidecar validation as modal prose rather than actions.

decision: All three initial failures were evaluator interpretation errors on examples explicitly defined by the production audit contract; retain the selected comments unchanged.
